legend: A bone marrow aspirate smear shows a micromegakaryocyte surrounded by increased numbers of blasts.

Bone marrow histology (<<39585>>) shows hypercellular bone marrow. Erythroid precursors and micromegakaryocytes are abnormally located, approaching bone trabeculae. Multinucleated megakaryocytes are present; megakaryocyte clustering is not conspicuous in this case but may be better appreciated using CD61 immunohistochemistry. Immature blasts are typically abnormally located away from trabeculae and sinuses. CD34 may be helpful in recognizing this feature. A significant degree of reticulin fibrosis (<<39586>>) may be present.
